Picarro CRDS
==========

Start up (up to 1h)
----------

 1. Start vacuum pump **first** (silver pump below the valve board, power switch on the backside). 
 2. Switch on the Picarro mains (Switch on backside, hard to reach)
 3. Press the Picarro power button
 4. Wait until the Picarro starts to measure (approx. 30min). The main screen of the Picarro shows then δ18O and δD values.
 5. Switch on CoWS mains (backside indicated by a white label on the top)
 6. Start the CoWS with the push button
 7. On the Picarro-Computer, start Coordinator Scripts from the Windows start menu, or the desktop
 8. Select CWS-JLU
 9. Check the settings, are they what you need (see wiki:devices/cwspicarro)
 10. It takes 15 min to warmup the CoWS, but you can already proceed with the next steps. Just don't start sampling

Shutdown (up to 20min)
--------
 1. From a terminal (eg. PuTTY) of the industrial PC execute `test/cwspicarro.py stop`
 2. On the Picarro-Desktop, switch to the Coordinator, it should now have as a last message `FSM thread finished`. If not, wait a minute, 
if it is still not appearing, proceed anyway
 3. Close the coordinator window, wait for the progressbar to finish or at least one minute
 4. Switch off the CoWS (switch on the backside indicated by a white label
 5. On the Picarro desktop go to the main Picarro Window (with the δD and δ18O graphs) and click shutdown. Select shutdown for shipping
 6. Wait for the Picarro CRDS to go off, this takes up to 15min.
 7. Switch off the main switch of the Picarro on the backside near the power cable.
 8. Switch off the vacuum pump (switch on backside also).
 9. If CoWS and CRDS will be transported sepeartly:
       - close the valves of the standard bags
       - disconnect the tubes at the CoWS (using the Swagelock connections)
